_about: The "I'm here as..." chooser on the home page and every state page. Each option points at a part of the guide that exists: a view (checked against every state's routes by tests/landing.cjs), an anchor on the page, or a page in this repository. An option with states shows only in those states.

more_help._about: Owner direction, November 28, 2026: guides link to each other by how visitors identify. Shown under the chooser on the home page and every state page: each option names who it is for and the free guide built for them. Every href is one of the guides in scripts/related_guides.py (or a page on one). An option with states shows only in those states.
